name: Forced Abroad - Tage eines Zwangsarbeiters
source:
At first, 19-year-old Jan was still lucky. He narrowly avoids capture during a National Socialist raid, who aim to deport all young men from his hometown, Rotterdam, into forced labor. Yet only a few weeks later he is also drafted into labor service and deported to Germany. In his diary, he records his experiences throughout the last months of the Second World War.

[From [url=https://paintbucket.de/en/game/forcedabroad]official website[/url]]
translation:
起初，19岁的简还算幸运。他在一次国家社会主义突袭中险些被捕，突袭的目的是将所有年轻人从他的家乡鹿特丹驱逐到强迫劳动中。然而仅仅几周后，他也被征召入伍并被驱逐到德国。他在日记中记录了第二次世界大战最后几个月的经历。

[来自[url=https://paintbucket.de/en/game/forcedabroad]官网[/url]]
